thread:
maya: FYI — proposing to UNBIND the runtime pin for gptx2 on hosted-prod during the next change window (Mar 12 00:00–02:00 UTC). Patch includes kvcache fix and aten kernel fallback. Need signoff on compatibility guard and rollback plan.

jonathan: SG. Have we validated quantized kernels on rtx6000 pools? Last time we saw hangs at seq>8k.

li-chen: we ran the longseq infra test yesterday on canary nodes with 2.14.3, saw a 0.4% op timeout at tail. not a showstopper but suggests adding a conservative kvcache TTL.

maya: thanks — proposed plan:
1) canary 5% traffic for 30m
2) enable roll-forward guard flag
3) auto-bind back if error-rate > 0.5% or p99 latency regresses > 20%
Thoughts?

andre: can we add an SDK shim check that rejects incompatible client versions? earlier SDK/runtime mismatches caused deserialization errors.

priya: +1. we'll add an opt-in header `X-RW-Compat: strict` that makes the server reject older SDKs and include migration notes in the release email.

jonathan: deploy-bot, schedule canary with config below:
```yaml
deploy:
  target: hosted-prod
  model_group: gptx2
  runtime_version: 2.14.3
  canary_pct: 5
  duration: 30m
  guard:
    error_rate_threshold: 0.005
    p99_latency_increase_pct: 20
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by jonathan. Job id: db-20230312-01. Auto-rollback hooks enabled. See https://deployments.redwood/example/db-20230312-01

li-chen: please whitelist partner/internal traffic from the canary to avoid surprise billing.

maya: done — partners and platform-tests are whitelisted. adding post-deploy smoke: `scripts/smoke_canary_check.sh` which asserts kv hit rate > 60%.

andre: if canary passes, rollout cadence?

maya: signal-based: 5 -> 25 -> 60 -> 100 over ~3h. manual hold at each step, abort conditions same as canary.

priya: I'll draft release notes & an email for customers covering the SDK shim, header, and rollback guidance.

jonathan: :thumbsup: Eng signoff. tagging @sre-handoff for monitoring and rollback readiness.

sre-handoff: on-call ack. will bump tracing and error-logging verbosity for canary nodes and watch tails.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback guard set -> `bind_pin: false`; protection TTL 2h. Maintenance window noted.

maya: final call — go for 03/12 00:00 UTC. If anything odd hit :rotating_light: and we'll revert to pinned runtime 2.14.2.
